"Create the foundation of a sophisticated mobile 3D grand strategy and realistic country-management simulation game.

GAME CONCEPT:
The player governs and develops a country inside a persistent, evolving world. The long-term vision includes realistic governments, politics, economics, populations, cities, infrastructure, diplomacy, technology, society, and many interconnected simulation systems.

IMPORTANT: This is Stage 1 only. Do not attempt to build every system yet. Build a stable, expandable foundation that future stages can extend without destroying or replacing existing features.

1. LANGUAGE:

- The entire playable game must be in Arabic.
- Use proper Arabic typography and full right-to-left (RTL) layout.
- All menus, buttons, labels, notifications, reports, maps, and in-game text must be Arabic.
- Use natural, professional Arabic terminology.
- Do not display English interface text to the player.

2. VISUAL DESIGN:
   Create a distinctive premium interface inspired by iOS 26 Liquid Glass.
   Do not copy Apple's interface directly.

Use an original, elegant color identity:

- Deep petroleum blue backgrounds.
- Muted jade green accents.
- Warm terracotta details.
- Soft champagne highlights.
- Warm ivory text.

Use translucent layered glass panels, realistic soft blur, subtle reflections, delicate borders, refined shadows, elegant typography, and smooth animations.

Avoid generic AI-generated design styles, excessive neon, repetitive purple-blue gradients, cluttered layouts, and oversized decorative elements.

The interface must feel sophisticated, calm, readable, and suitable for long gaming sessions.

3. GAME WORLD FOUNDATION:

- Create an initial interactive 3D or convincing 2.5D world map.
- Show a country with identifiable borders, terrain, cities, villages, rivers, and roads.
- Allow camera movement, zooming, and rotation where supported.
- Make the world visually attractive and prepare it for future expansion.
- Do not use a static decorative image as a substitute for an interactive map.

4. MAIN GAME INTERFACE:
   Create an Arabic main dashboard containing:

- Overview of the country.
- Government.
- Economy.
- Population.
- Infrastructure.
- World map.
- Notifications and events.
- Statistics and reports.

These sections must have a consistent navigation system and expandable architecture.

5. BASIC SIMULATION:
   Implement a functioning initial simulation with:

- Country treasury.
- Population.
- Government stability.
- Economic condition.
- Simulation date.
- A working pause and resume control.
- Three simulation speeds.

Values must be connected to actual game state. Do not use random decorative numbers.

6. MOBILE EXPERIENCE:
   Design for portrait and landscape mobile screens where supported.
   Ensure touch-friendly controls, readable Arabic text, smooth navigation, and responsive layouts.

7. DEVELOPMENT RULES:

- Build actual interactive functionality, not just a visual mockup.
- Keep the project modular and expandable.
- Preserve existing systems when future features are added.
- Do not replace working systems with simplified placeholders.
- Avoid unnecessary complexity in this first stage.
- Test the main interface and simulation controls before completing this stage.

At the end, provide a playable initial prototype of the game. Do not move on to Stage 2 automatically.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Stage 1 foundation for a sophisticated Arabic mobile 3D/2.5D grand strategy country-management game.

## Requirements
- Entire interface and text in natural, professional Arabic with full RTL layout.
- Premium petroleum-blue, jade, terracotta, champagne, and ivory visual identity.
- Interactive map with borders, terrain, cities, villages, rivers, roads, movement, zoom, and rotation.
- Dashboard sections for overview, government, economy, population, infrastructure, map, notifications, and reports.
- Functional treasury, population, stability, economy, date, pause/resume, and three speeds.
- Modular, expandable architecture with local saving and responsive portrait/landscape support.

## Decisions
- Stage 1 implemented as a static HTML/CSS/JavaScript application.
- Used a custom interactive SVG map rather than a 3D dependency.
- Added a local-storage save system and actual day-based simulation updates.
- Reused the same dashboard architecture for all navigation sections.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created complete Arabic RTL game shell and premium glass interface.
- Implemented interactive country map with drag, zoom, rotation, city interactions, and map modes.
- Added navigation, overview, government, economy, population, infrastructure, notification, and report sections.
- Added simulation controls, actual state updates, policy actions, and local saving.
- Added mobile and landscape responsive layouts.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Run the project, test desktop and mobile rendering, and verify all navigation and simulation controls.
2. Inspect a captured browser screenshot for visual defects.
3. Continue with Stage 2 only if the user explicitly requests it.

## Relevant Files

## Objective

## Requirements
- واجهة عربية كاملة بعرض RTL.
- هوية بصرية زرقاء بترولية وخضراء تيراكوتا وشمبانيا وعاجية.
- خريطة تفاعلية، مؤشرات ملزمة، وأقسام إدارة وحفظ محلي.
- دعم سطح المكتب والمحمول وأوضاع البورتريت واللاندسكيب.

## Decisions
- تعتمد المنصة على HTML/CSS/JavaScript ثابتة وخريطة SVG مخصصة.
- يستخدم الحفظ المحلي مفتاح `marafe-game-state-v1`.
- تتقدم المحاكاة يوماً واحداً كل 6 ثوانٍ عند السرعة 1×، ويُضاعف أثرها عند 2× و4×.

## Work State
### Completed
- بناء واجهة اللعبة، واللوحات، ونظام التنقل، والمحاكاة، والحفظ المحلي، والخريطة التفاعلية.
- تشغيل خادم اختبار على المنفذ `4173`.
